status.description: Bounded worker outcome: done proposes completion, needs_input asks lead a question, and blocked reports a blocker. A done proposal still requires independent verification.

step_id.description: Exact nonempty step ID supplied in the controlled-run packet.

summary.description: Conclusion containing non-whitespace text. Put explanations and nonblocking limitations here or in evidence.

artifacts.description: Paths to existing FILES under the allowed artifact root, unique after resolution. Relative paths resolve from that root; absolute paths and symlinks are checked by their resolved targets. Directories are invalid. An empty array is valid.

question.description: For needs_input, a question containing non-whitespace text. For done or blocked, exactly the empty string.

reason.description: For done, exactly the empty string; nonblocking explanations belong in summary/evidence. For blocked, a reason containing non-whitespace text. For needs_input, any string, including empty or explanatory text.

evidence.description: Nonblank check descriptions or references. An empty array is valid; nonblocking limitations may be recorded here.
